details: Subcommands: ``enhance``/``prepare`` binarise and deskew the images for Tesseract, ``grid-variants``/``grid-search`` try the image variants and the oem/psm settings, ``ocr`` extracts the text (plus a JSON report and CSV with ``-j``) and ``translate`` OCRs and translates the result.

oldpi.py.summary: Detect and fix the Python 2 ``print`` statements.
details: Finds the ``print x`` lines with a regex confirmed by tokenize (skipping the Rich ``print`` imports and the commented-out code), reports them and with ``-a`` rewrites them as ``print(x)`` calls; large files are read through an mmap.

opng.py.summary: Optimise PNG files in place with optipng.
details: Runs optipng (``-o`` level 7, ``--strip all``) on each PNG, validates the result and keeps it only when the new file is smaller; ``--dry-run``, ``-q``, extra optipng arguments and a timeout are supported, and the tree is walked with a process pool.

pbat.py.summary: A Python port of the ``bat`` cat clone with syntax highlighting.
details: Prints the files with Pygments highlighting, line numbers, a header, the git change markers and the grid, supports the ``-r`` line ranges, ``-H`` line highlighting, the themes, the languages, the paging and the plain output, and reads stdin with ``-``.

pdf2page.py.summary: Extract every PDF page into its own text file.
details: Chooses between pdfminer, pypdf, PyMuPDF and pdfplumber (``-b``), writes one file per page into ``<pdf_dir>/<stem>/`` with a configurable name template, uses threads for the fitz/plumber backends and processes the rest, with ``--skip-existing`` for the resumes.

pdf2text.py.summary: Extract the text of PDF files with PyPDF2 or pdfplumber.
details: The ``concat`` subcommand writes the whole document to one ``.txt``, ``split`` one file per page into a folder named after the PDF; the engine, the encoding, the page-number padding and the quiet mode are configurable.

pdftools.py.summary: PDF text extraction, split, merge and resource extraction with PyMuPDF.
details: ``-p`` writes the per-page text, ``-s`` splits the pages into single-page PDFs, ``-m`` merges the inputs into ``merged.pdf`` and ``-x`` extracts the embedded images, fonts and attachments into ``<stem>/images``, ``fonts`` and ``<stem>/attachments``; the work runs in parallel.

pdftools2.py.summary: PDF toolkit for outlines, merging, images and shrinking.
details: Subcommands: ``outline`` builds the bookmarks from a mdBook ``SUMMARY.md`` (optionally checking the titles), ``merge`` combines the files, ``to-img`` renders the JPGs, ``rename-pages`` appends the page count to the names, ``shrink`` uses Ghostscript or qpdf, ``split-size`` cuts the files at a maximum size and ``split-page`` writes one file per page.

pdftoolz.py.summary: PDF toolkit with the same subcommands as :doc:`pdftools2`.
details: ``outline`` resolves the mdBook ``SUMMARY.md`` anchors against the HTML ids and builds the TOC, ``merge``/``to-img``/``rename-pages``/``shrink``/``split-size``/``split-page`` cover the rest; the implementation uses PyMuPDF for the outline and the Ghostscript/qpdf engines for the compression.

pdfv.py.summary: Read the text of a PDF in a terminal viewer.
details: Extracts the page text with PyMuPDF, wraps it to the terminal width and pages through it in the alternate screen with the arrow/page keys, opening the page given with ``-p``.

pdfv2.py.summary: View a PDF in the terminal, rendered as an image.
details: Renders the pages through an external ``pdftoppm``-style helper into PPM, draws them in the alternate screen with the ANSI colour blocks and lets you scroll, change the page and zoom (``-z``) with the keyboard.

pdfview.py.summary: Page through the extracted text of the PDFs found in a tree.
details: Finds the ``.pdf`` files, extracts the pages with pdfminer, pypdf, PyMuPDF or a system OCR tool (``-b auto`` tries the Python ones first) and shows a scrollable pager with the page navigation across the files.

pdfviewer.py.summary: Render a PDF in the terminal with PyMuPDF.
details: Draws the current page as text or as coloured half-blocks with the zoom factor, and handles the paging, the scrolling and the quit keys in the alternate screen.

pip_reinstaller.py.summary: Reinstall the pure-Python packages, or the packages of a list.
details: Collects the installed pure-Python distributions (or parses ``-f`` package file), processes them in batches of ten and reinstalls each with ``pip --force-reinstall --no-deps``, reporting the failures.

pkg_deps_reporter.py.summary: Report the dependencies of the installed packages by reading their ``METADATA``.
details: Parses the ``Requires-Dist`` lines of a package's dist-info (``-d`` sets the site-packages root) or of every installed package with ``-a``, and prints or writes the dependency report (``-w``).

pkg_insoector.py.summary: Inspect the installed Python packages for duplicates, versions and scripts.
details: Subcommands: ``duplicates`` finds the packages in both the system and user site-packages, ``multi-version`` the repeated versions, ``missing-scripts``/``entrypoints`` check the console scripts, ``binary`` lists the packages with compiled extensions, ``orphans`` the files no distribution owns and ``small`` the undersized packages; ``--report`` and ``--split`` export the results.
